Social media has many effects on society, including positive and negative effects. Social media is a very large group, including applications, programs, and many more. Also, social media has turned from entertainment to a very important means through which a person can carry out all work and tasks. Also, it greatly affects the culture and economy of society, and its positive impact on society is an increase in scientific productivity, an increase in economic power, and also a decrease in the unemployment rate. Among the negatives are laziness, spreading false rumors and negatively affecting the health of individuals.

The UAE is one of the most constantly changing and developing countries in the world. Whether it is a social, academic, or constructional development, The UAE will most probably be developing and eventually excelling at it. It is an accepting country with a diverse range of people living in it. I personally thing that the most important developments in the UAE are the ones that involve the society, Because no matter how amazing the schooling is, or how luxurious the destination might be, If the society is not loving and accepting towards one another then it would not have as many tourists as it would if it was. The tolerance movement in The UAE has helped the society become more familial with one another and it resulted in the tourism to spike. The UAE hand signal ( Peace, Love and Victory ) has designed a nation which is known for its peace and serenity with different cultures and ethnicities. The tourism in the UAE would not be so successful if the society was not so loving. If the UAE did not have as much luxury as it does now, but the society was just as amazing, then i can guarantee you that tourism would not be affected because we have other things to offer (Culture, pearl diving market, fish market, agriculture, gold, and diversity). so in conclusion, The most important developments in the UAE are the societal developments because they control most of the UAE's success.

Social media is an incredibly powerful source. Depending on how you use it, it can make or break you. There are multiple very influential social media platforms that have changed many people's lives forever such as; Snapchat, Twitter, Instagram, and the new infamous Tik Tok. These apps or websites can be a tool to help you get to where you wanna be, or can be a trigger to unhealthy habits and abuse. Thousands of people have used social media to grow an audience, gain insights, ideas, and establish theirselves financially through it. This is not limited only to the average person, but we also see it from corporations, stores, restaurants and so much more. Algorithms are formed on our phones and tablets to cater to our interests, that's why we get ads of all our favorite things when we are scrolling through the internet. Anything that has this much power and influence of society can also be a very dangerous thing. Social media has been studied and found to have significant risks for causing depression, anxiety, loneliness, self harm, and even suicidal thoughts. Many people that are vulnerable are prone to negative experiences due to social media such as the feeling of inadequacy about life or appearance. Overall, Social media has undeniably played a substantial part in society. How you go about using social media is not to be taken lightly, it can either be a great tool to reach success or an anchor that drags you down.
